name: production-snippets
description: Reference implementations for production connection, resilience, caching, and lifecycle patterns.

interface.shortDescription: Reference implementations for production reliability patterns
interface.longDescription: Design and review Redis lifecycle and TLS, retry with backoff and idempotency, cache-aside with stampede protection, database and HTTP client connection management, and health checks with graceful shutdown, each documented for versions, failure, cleanup, security, observability, tests, and tradeoffs.
defaultPrompt: Design a production-safe implementation of this connection, retry, cache, or lifecycle concern.
